final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), paired AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / total_count AS ratio FROM state_counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM state_counts) WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS mean_count FROM paired) SELECT SUM(p.invoice_count) AS total_counts, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.invoice_count - a.mean_count) AS average_difference FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE a.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND p.invoice_count > a.mean_count
